caption_en:
Perfect democracy: 100. Israel: 78.

What's in the gap? Israel's own weak spots on the Economist's Democracy Index (2024): civil liberties 5.6 out of 10, political culture 6.9, functioning of government 7.5.

Zoom out, same scale (x10): 🇮🇱 Israel 78, 🇹🇷 Turkey 43, 🇱🇧 Lebanon 36, 🇯🇴 Jordan 33, 🇦🇪 UAE 31, 🇪🇬 Egypt 28, 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia 21, 🇮🇷 Iran 20. Below 40 is what the Economist calls authoritarian. Israel is the region's only democracy on the index.

Honest catch: Israel is still a "flawed democracy", 31st in the world.

We're not perfect. We know it. But "no democracy"? We're closer to a perfect one than anyone around us.

Send this to a critic.
caption_he:
דמוקרטיה מושלמת: 100. ישראל: 78.
בפער: חירויות אזרח 5.6 מתוך 10, תרבות פוליטית 6.9, תפקוד הממשלה 7.5.
זום אאוט: טורקיה 43, לבנון 36, ירדן 33, האמירויות 31, מצרים 28, סעודיה 21, איראן 20. מתחת ל־40 זה משטר אוטוריטרי לפי האקונומיסט.
ובכנות: גם ישראל היא "דמוקרטיה פגומה", מקום 31 בעולם.
לא מושלמים. אבל הכי קרובים לדמוקרטיה מושלמת באזור.

Source: The Economist Intelligence Unit, Democracy Index 2024.

lines.line: This is a perfect democracy. Israel is here.
Seventy-eight out of a hundred, on the Economist's Democracy Index.
What's in the gap? Civil liberties: fifty-six.
Now zoom out. Critics say Israel is no democracy at all.
No democracy looks like this: below forty, where the Economist puts authoritarian regimes.
Turkey, forty-three. Lebanon, thirty-six. Jordan, thirty-three. The Emirates, thirty-one. Egypt, twenty-eight. Saudi Arabia, twenty-one. Iran, twenty.
Israel is the only democracy on this chart.
One honest catch: even Israel is only a flawed democracy, thirty-first in the world.
We're not perfect. We know it.
But no democracy? We're closer to a perfect one than anyone around us.
